exposure: timing of umbilical cord clamping (1 minute vs 2 minutes)
cohort: Neonates born to 218 inducted females participating in the study were divided into two groups based on cord clamping time.
finding: Delayed cord clamping at 2 minutes resulted in significantly higher neonatal hematocrit and hemoglobin levels compared to cord clamping at 1 minute.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery showed a significant difference with neonatal hematocrit and hemoglobin levels.
gest_age: Gestational age was analyzed as a factor, but no specific range for participants was mentioned.
